name: the_double_entry_page
conceit: A scribe's two-column ledger page -- empty and ruled, then filling with paired vignettes (wounds/thorns on one side, ordinary bowed figures on the other) connected by red transfer lines across the gutter -- until the ruling itself resolves into the shape of a plain cross at the close. One still (_02, the mid-fill transfer-lines still) landed exactly as designed; the empty-page and cross-resolution stills (_01, _03) drifted toward a photoreal accounting-book photograph rather than the intended hand-inked illustration.

anti: a story with only a single narrative line and no real one-to-one paired correspondence set to enter into two columns
a beat needing a hand-lettered number or word -- ledgers invite the model to want to write legible entries, which this style forbids

plate_bill.must_contain: ruled two-column ledger page divided by one strong vertical center rule, almost entirely bare and unfilled, warm raking light

the same ruled ledger page, each column holding several soft-edged ink vignettes (wounds/thorns one side, ordinary bowed figures the other), 2-3 fine red transfer lines crossing the gutter connecting them

completed ruled ledger page: the vertical and a bottom horizontal rule intersect, red transfer lines from both columns converge there so the ruling resolves into the shape of a plain cross, a closing double rule beneath

motion_slots.earned_by: the red transfer-lines crossing the gutter (P2, the still that landed cleanly) is the one beat worth animating the lines actually being drawn/traveling; the bare-page and cross-resolution stills need a rebuild before any motion budget is spent on them.

risk_flags: illustration_lock -- _01 and _03 both drifted toward a photographed-accounting-book look; rebuild with tighter hand-inked/illustration language before reusing either

beat_template.hook: the empty ruled ledger, two bare columns, expectant
beat_template.pivot: vignettes and red transfer lines fill both columns, crossing the gutter
beat_template.landing: the ruling itself resolves into a plain cross, the account closed

score_shape: a dry, measured ruled-paper tick under the empty page, warming as the vignettes and transfer-lines fill in, resolving to one held plain chord as the ruling becomes a cross.
evidence: poc_bethesda_style_test/round2_devices/stills/double_entry_01.png, double_entry_02.png, double_entry_03.png (double_entry_02 is the clean one; 01/03 drifted photoreal)
